# Sample Mountain Loop

## Trip facts

- Dates: 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-04
- Travelers: 4
- Transport: private SUV

## Trip summary

| Day | Route | Drive | Stay | Highlights |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| D1 | Arrival | 1 hour | Gateway | Dinner and rest |
| D2 | Gateway to lake | 3-5 hours | Lake | Scenic road and lake |
| D3 | Lake to village | 3-4.5 hours | Village | Mountain viewpoint |
| D4 | Village to gateway | 3-5 hours | Gateway | Return |

## Detailed itinerary

### D1: Arrival

- Meet at the airport and check into the hotel.
- Confirm the next day's route and weather.

### D2: Lake route

- 09:00 depart after breakfast.
- Scenic road stops are conditional on traffic.
- Stay near the lake.

### D3: Mountain route

- Visit the main viewpoint.
- Use the optional branch only in clear weather.

### D4: Return

- Keep a traffic buffer for the return journey.
